pinStrategy: clone default branch (most community plugins have no git tags)

plugins.name: File Gallery
plugins.author: Tophness and Neires
plugins.description: Adds a Gallery tab that allows you to view metadata of all files in your output folders, join video frames with a single click, and more

plugins.name: Finetune Manager
plugins.author: GKartist75
plugins.description: Community finetune registry: browse, load, create, edit, improve, and upload finetune JSONs for Wan2GP

plugins.name: HideUI
plugins.author: MrKuenning
plugins.description: A plugin for WAN2GP to allow toggling UI elements.

plugins.name: Image Suite
plugins.author: saintorphan
plugins.description: Image workbench: Txt2Img, Img2Img, MultiCanvas (layered draw / mask / inpaint) and a Modify editor (crop / resize / flip / colour) for Flux, Z-Image and the SDXL lineup (Pony, Illustrious). Save any result to the other pages, Img2Vid, the Prompt Library, disk — or, with the SendTo plugin, to other tabs and plugins.

plugins.name: LTX Director
plugins.author: The-ShadowWalker (WhatDreamsCost, ported to Wan2GP)
plugins.description: Timeline editor: zoom fix, sliding-window bands + WanGP relay (PW/FG prompt modes), real waveforms with audio playback, deduplicated zip sessions.

plugins.name: LoRA Manager
plugins.author: Tophness
plugins.description: Manage local LoRAs with lset support and granular prompt/file injection.

plugins.name: LoRA Merger
plugins.author: Tophness
plugins.description: Advanced LoRA Merger with granular block control and drift visualization.

plugins.name: Lora Multipliers UI
plugins.author: Tophness
plugins.description: Dynamically set lora multipliers with a fast, JavaScript-powered UI.

plugins.name: Lora Organizer
plugins.author: ppc2017
plugins.description: Lora Organizer adds a UI to the lora tab, letting you organize loras into groups and subgroups, store metadata, and activate loras with their trigger words and strength in one click.

plugins.name: Multi-Angle Prompt Helper
plugins.author: CodeBarrie
plugins.description: 3D orbit gizmo + prompt helper for multi-angle camera control. Drag to set azimuth, elevation, and distance with visual feedback.

plugins.name: Pixel Upsampler Template
plugins.author: DeepBeepMeep
plugins.description: Template spatial upsampler plugin that duplicates pixels and documents the WanGP upsampler API for plugin developers.

plugins.name: Prompt Library
plugins.author: saintorphan
plugins.description: Standalone, model-agnostic prompt library in the Media Generation tab: save / update / populate / delete prompts, optionally preserving every generation parameter, each tagged with the model selected when it was saved.

plugins.name: Prompt Manager
plugins.author: David Brum
plugins.description: Browse generated images and videos with search, sort, and grid size controls. Copy metadata, generate in-plugin, manage a saved library with export/import, and bulk actions on multi-select.

plugins.name: Pulsebar
plugins.author: Javier-bat
plugins.description: Windows floating always-on-top progress bar for Wan2GP generations.

plugins.name: Queue Editor
plugins.author: Tophness
plugins.description: Perform advanced/bulk queue.zip operations offline without affecting your main generator queue.

plugins.name: Queue Notifier
plugins.author: Javier-bat
plugins.description: Queue notifier for current WanGP saved-output flow, with optional generated media attachments, extended Telegram upload timeouts, task completion/failure and per-task percentage alerts, UI settings, persistent config, and Apprise channels (Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp/IFTTT/Google Chat).

plugins.name: Stable Diffusion 1.4 Model Plugin
plugins.author: DeepBeepMeep
plugins.description: Template model plugin that adds Stable Diffusion 1.4 through WanGP's model-plugin discovery path.

plugins.name: VRAM / RAM Adjuster
plugins.description: Adjust the Gpu Vram and System Ram - Override the Memory Profiles

plugins.name: Wildcards
plugins.author: GKartist75 (with PI Agent)
plugins.description: Dynamic wildcard expansion for prompts + named variables + templates + character profiles + usage stats. Use __name__ syntax for random picks, __$var:file__ for reusable captured variables.

plugins.name: wan2gp-blender-upsampler
plugins.author: DeepBeepMeep
plugins.description: Template temporal upsampler plugin that creates x2 intermediate frames by blending neighboring frames.
